title: Page 5
content_zh:
“只是检査一下，拿来。”他们缓缓朝她走近，再走近。

席舞退了又退，终是鼓起勇气，抓紧相机立刻转身就跑——

“站住！”

一堆人在后头追她。

身后疾速的脚步声不断地传来，让席舞紧张得只能拼命往前跑，什么都顾不得——

“救命！谁来救我啊！”她边跑边叫。

根本没人敢理她。

或者说，根本没人来得及理她。

俱乐部里的人都悠闲度日惯了，香槟美酒佳人，对目前你追我跑的场面都十分错愕。

“救命啊，拜托，有人帮帮忙吗？”就算没人理，她也继续乱叫，总不能这样“默默”被抓走吧？

俱乐部里的人不算多也不算少，那几个高大黑衣人却毫不忌讳地当众追赶她，完全不顾旁人目光，由此可见他们对她的相机是势在必得……

该死的！他们该不会以为她的相机有可能拍下他们做坏事的证据，所以才对她穷追不舍吧？

那味道，是血没错。

所以在她离开的那二十分钟里，那个包厢内可能发生砍人事件？可她没看见受伤的人啊……被抬走了？是死了，还是伤了？

席舞想到刚刚才关掉的录影功能，想到她来取回相机之前，相机的镜头刚好正对着包厢内部……

天啊，不会吧？她的相机不会这么倒楣，刚好拍到人家行凶的画面吧？

一想到这个可能性极大，席舞头皮就一阵发麻，更加死命往前跑，但夜路走多了，总会撞到……人，这人的胸膛硬得很，害她这一撞还真是有点头昏眼花，上气不接下气了。

“救命……对不起，我不是故意要撞你的……”席舞喘着，根本语无伦次，双手紧紧攀住对方。“救我，有人要抓我……”

她其实不抱希望的，有点脑子的人都不会在什么状况都没弄清楚之前，出手帮她去对抗好几名高大的黑西装大汉，那些人一看就知道非善类啊，白痴才会蹚陌生人的浑水。

可她这人呢，只要有一丝丝希望都不会放弃的，既然这人被她撞到了就代表有缘啊，求上一求是一定要的，就算被拒绝也无憾。

第13章(2)

她等着被这人狠狠甩开，没想到等半天，这人非但没有甩开她，还一把搂住头昏眼花又气喘吁吁的她。

“救了你，你要怎么报答我？”

头顶上，传来一阵好听又熟悉得要命的嗓音……

竟是……齐藤英树？他怎么也在这里？是她耳背，还是产生幻听？

席舞蓦地抬起头来，望向这个胸膛的主人——不是他是谁？就算他戴着墨镜，她也可以一眼认出他来。而且，要不是刚刚被撞到头昏眼花，光他身上的味道她应该就可以认出他了吧？

“干么傻傻地看着我？回答我，我若救了你，你拿什么报答我？”齐藤英树温柔地睨着在怀中的她。

那兜在她脸上的眼神，深情得让她的心扑通扑通乱跳。

“我……我……你想要我怎么报答？”

他低笑一声。“以身相许如何？”

“你——”

“不愿意就拉倒，反正我跟你很不熟。”说着，齐藤英树便要把她从他身上拉开似地伸手去扯她。

席舞反手把他抓得更紧。“许就许！你不可以不管我！”

“这可是你亲口答应的。”

“一言既出，驷马难追，我席舞说到做到！你不能赖！”

齐藤英树又笑。“好吧，那我就帮帮你。”

话方落，就听到前头传来一声冷笑——

“这位先生，我劝你不要多管闲事。”带头的大哥凶恶无比地瞪着他。“这儿可是我们的地盘。”

齐藤英树眉一挑，浅浅一笑。“这间俱乐部是你家主人开的？”

带头的大哥一愣，显然被他的问话给问住了。“不是，可是——”

“既然不是，你们却想在人家的地盘上打打杀杀？一大群男人追着一个女人跑，成何体统？”

“只要她交出相机，我们不会为难她的。”

“相机？”齐藤英树低头看了席舞一眼。“相机是谁的？”

“当然是我的！那天我拍你的时候就是用这台相机拍的——”

“听见了吗？”齐藤英树微笑地打断席舞，转看向那几个男人。“相机里有我的裸照，实在不方便给各位。”

席舞倏地抬起头来看他，带头大哥闻言也皱眉。

“大哥，不要听他罗嗦，把东西抢过来就是，不然如果出了什么事，我们怎么跟老大交代？”一旁的小弟转了转拳头，从袖口抽出一把刀。

锋利的刀锋亮晃了人的眼，周围传出了一阵尖叫声——

“快叫保全！”有人开口。“保全在搞什么东西，都闹成这样了还不出现？那些人究竟是怎么混进来的？”

刚刚还来不及反应的大家，这会儿终是乱成一团。

“报警吧。”有人边说边打起手机。

怕被曝光的人则赶紧拿东西走人。

齐藤英树气定神闲，只是轻轻地把怀中的女人推开了些。“躲到我身后，躲好一点，怕血就把眼睛闭上……不用怕，我会保护你。”

“我不怕。”因为有你在。席舞给他一抹笑，乖乖地躲到他身后去。

她才一动，对方便出手，几个人围攻齐藤英树一人，席舞知道他身手矫健又身怀武艺，她今天遇见他根本等于遇见神，知道自己定能逃过一劫，可虽说如此，她在一旁还是看得紧张万分。

对方小弟手上有刀，刀还十分锋利，虽然相信他定能闪过，但这么多人打他一个，难免会顾此失彼……

正想着呢，孰料那小弟刀锋一转，不去对付他，反倒乘隙朝她猛刺过来——

“啊！”她吓得叫出声，忙不迭蹲下，两手下意识举起，环住了脸和头。

刀没落下……

她听到一声极低的闷哼，接下来是那名小弟的痛喊声。

“该死！快走！”带头大哥大喝一声，叫人撤退。

众兄弟倒很听话，说散就散，转眼不见踪影。

耳边安静得只听得见某人浓重的呼吸声……

席舞把脸偷偷探了出来，齐藤英树正居高临下地瞅着她，对她伸出了手。

“起来吧，像个小老鼠似的。”

他在取笑她？

席舞忍不住瞪他一眼，拉着他的手站起身，却眼尖地看见他手背上被刀划过的一道血痕——

她倏地抓过他的手。“你受伤了？流血了！”

齐藤英树看了她一眼，想抽回手，她却抓着不放，想了想，索性让她抓着，毕竟要不是他受了伤，要等她主动过来牵他的手，不知要等到何年何月。

“怎么会伤了？你的身手不是很厉害的吗？”

闻言，他挑眉，想问她又是怎么知道他身手很厉害的？一贯冷嘲热讽的唇才要掀起，手背上却滴落一股温热……

一滴又一滴，无声无息，却又烫手。

齐藤英树黑眸一黯，瞅着她的眼闪过一抹幽光。

“哭什么？只不过是一点小伤。”

他说得越是云淡风清，席舞的泪掉得越凶。

“都是我不好，是我害了你，才会让这么漂亮的手给弄伤了……”她哭着抹泪，说起话来有点泣不成声。

挑着眉，他不以为然道：“练武之人怎么可能不受伤？你为了这一点小伤就哭成这样，以后怎么办？”

听不懂……

“什么以后？”她张着泪眼看他。

装傻？还是真的笨？齐藤英树笑着，用另一只手替她抹去泪。

“走吧，再不走，等会可能走不掉了。”那群人打不过他，势必找来更多人，要是动了枪，他再厉害也躲不掉。
content_en:
"Just checking, bring it." They walked towards her slowly, then closer.

Xi Wu retreated and retreated, but finally mustered up the courage to grab the camera and immediately turned around and ran away——

"Stop!"

A bunch of people were chasing her.

The sound of rapid footsteps behind him kept coming, making Xi Wu so nervous that he could only run forward as hard as he could, without caring about anything -

"Help! Someone come and save me!" she shouted while running.

No one dared to pay attention to her at all.

In other words, no one had time to pay attention to her.

The people in the club are used to spending their days leisurely, and the ladies with champagne and wine are very surprised by the current scene of you chasing me.

"Help, please, can someone help me?" Even if no one paid attention, she continued to scream. She couldn't be taken away "silently" like this, right?

There were neither too many nor too few people in the club, but those tall men in black chased her in public without any hesitation, completely ignoring the eyes of others. This shows that they are bound to capture her camera...

Damn it!Did they think that her camera might capture evidence of them doing bad things, so they pursued her?

That smell is definitely blood.

So during the twenty minutes she left, there might have been a stabbing incident in that box?But she didn't see the injured person... being carried away?Is he dead or injured?

Xi Wu thought about the video recording function that she had just turned off, and thought that before she came to retrieve the camera, the lens of the camera was facing the inside of the box...

Oh my god, no?Her camera couldn't be so unlucky and just happened to capture the scene of the murder, right?

Xi Wu's scalp felt numb at the thought of this great possibility, and she ran forward even more desperately. However, if she walked too much at night, she would always bump into... someone. This person's chest was so hard that she was really dizzy and out of breath from the collision.

"Help... I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bump into you..." Xi Wu gasped, her words completely incoherent, and she held onto the other person tightly with her hands."Save me, someone wants to arrest me..."

She actually had no hope. No one with any sense would help her fight against several tall men in black suits before they figured out the situation. Those people could tell at a glance that they were not kind, and only idiots would wade into the muddy waters of strangers.

But she is a person who will not give up as long as there is a glimmer of hope. Since this person is bumped into by her, it means that she is destined. She must ask for it, and she will have no regrets even if she is rejected.

Chapter 13(2)

She waited for this man to throw her away, but she didn't expect that after waiting for a long time, this man not only didn't throw her away, but also hugged her, who was dizzy and out of breath.

"How will you repay me for saving you?"

Above the head, there was a pleasant and familiar voice...

It was... Saito Hideki?Why is he here?Is she deaf, or is she hearing hallucinations?

Xi Wu suddenly raised his head and looked at the owner of this chest - who was he?Even if he was wearing sunglasses, she could recognize him immediately.Moreover, if she hadn't been knocked dizzy just now, she would have recognized him just by the smell of him, right?

"Why are you looking at me stupidly? Answer me, if I save you, what will you do in return?" Saito Hideki looked at her tenderly in his arms.

The look on her face was so affectionate that it made her heart beat wildly.

"I...I...how do you want me to repay you?"

He chuckled."How about I pledge myself to you?"

"You——"

"Pull her down if you don't want to. Anyway, I'm not familiar with you." After saying that, Saito Hideki stretched out his hand to pull her away from him.

Xi Wu held him tighter with her backhand."Promise! You can't ignore me!"

"This is what you promised yourself."

"What I say is hard to follow. I, Xi Wu, will do what I say! You can't rely on me!"

Saito Hideki laughed again."Okay, then I'll help you."

Just as he finished speaking, he heard a sneer coming from in front of him——

"Sir, I advise you not to mind your own business." The elder brother who took the lead glared at him fiercely."This is our territory."

Saito Hideki raised his eyebrows and smiled lightly."Is this club opened by your master?"

The eldest brother who took the lead was stunned for a moment, obviously stunned by his question."No, but-"

"Since it's not the case, you want to fight and kill others on their territory? How unbecoming is it for a large group of men to chase a woman?"

"As long as she hands over the camera, we won't embarrass her."

"Camera?" Saito Hideki lowered his head and glanced at Xi Wu."Whose camera is it?"

"Of course it's mine! When I photographed you that day, I used this camera -"

"Did you hear that?" Saito Hideki interrupted Xi Wu with a smile and turned to look at the men."There are nude photos of me in the camera, so it's really inconvenient for you to share them."

Xi Wu suddenly raised her head to look at him, and the leader also frowned when he heard this.

"Brother, don't listen to his wordy words. Just grab the things. Otherwise, if something happens, how will we explain to the boss?" The younger brother on the side turned his fist and pulled out a knife from his sleeve.

The sharp blade dazzled people's eyes, and there was a scream from all around -

"Call security!" someone said."What is the security doing? Why don't you show up after all the trouble? How did those people get in?"

Everyone who had no time to react just now was finally in a mess.

"Call the police." Someone said while talking on the phone.

People who are afraid of being exposed quickly take their things and leave.

Saito Hideki was calm and composed, and just gently pushed the woman in his arms away."Hide behind me, hide well, and close your eyes if you're afraid of blood... Don't be afraid, I will protect you."

"I'm not afraid." Because you are here.Xi Wu gave him a smile and hid behind him obediently.

As soon as she moved, the opponent took action. Several people besieged Saito Hideki alone. Xi Wu knew that he was strong and talented in martial arts. When she met him today, it was like meeting God. She knew that she would definitely escape. But even so, she was still extremely nervous watching from the sidelines.

The other boy has a knife in his hand, and the knife is very sharp. Although I believe he can dodge it, but with so many people hitting him, it is inevitable that they will lose sight of one thing...

Just as she was thinking about it, who would have expected that the younger brother's blade turned and instead of dealing with him, he took the opportunity to stab her fiercely——

"Ah!" She screamed in fright, hurriedly squatted down, raised her hands subconsciously, and covered her face and head.

The knife did not fall...

She heard a very low groan, followed by the boy's cry of pain.

"Damn it! Let's go!" The leader shouted and told people to retreat.

The brothers were very obedient and dispersed as soon as they were told, disappearing in the blink of an eye.

It was so quiet that all I could hear was someone's heavy breathing...

Xi Wu peeked her face out. Saito Hideki was looking at her condescendingly and stretched out his hand to her.

"Get up like a little mouse."

Is he making fun of her?

Xi Wu couldn't help but glare at him, took his hand and stood up, but sharply saw a blood mark on the back of his hand scratched by a knife——

She quickly grabbed his hand."Are you injured? You're bleeding!"

Saito Hideki glanced at her and wanted to take his hand away, but she held on to it. After thinking about it, he simply let her hold on to him. After all, if he hadn't been injured, he would have had to wait for how long it would take for her to take the initiative to hold his hand.

"Why is it hurt? Aren't you very skilled?"

Hearing this, he raised his eyebrows and wanted to ask her how she knew he was very skilled?Just as he was about to raise his sarcastic lips, warmth dripped from the back of his hand...

Drop after drop, silent but hot.

Saito Hideki's dark eyes dimmed, and a faint light flashed in his eyes as he looked at her.

"Why are you crying? It's just a small injury."

The more calm and clear he spoke, the harder Xi Wu's tears fell.

"It's all my fault. It's me who hurt you. That's why such a beautiful hand was injured..." She cried and wiped her tears, a little choked with tears when she spoke.

He raised his eyebrows and said disapprovingly: "How can a martial arts practitioner not get hurt? You cried like this because of this small injury. What will you do in the future?"

Can't understand...

"What's next?" She looked at him with tearful eyes.

Playing dumb?Or really stupid?Saito Hideki smiled and wiped away her tears with his other hand.

"Let's go. If you don't leave, you may not be able to leave later." If those people couldn't defeat him, they would definitely find more people. If a gun was fired, he wouldn't be able to hide no matter how powerful he was.
